vectors.description: Section 3.6.2 verbatim: SAP type 2 at the start of each 4 s Group and SAP type 3 at Object 60. The vector asserts the records only; the draft states neither the frames per Object nor where the skipped RASL pictures sit, so the times cannot be checked against the prose.
One record: Group 0, Object 0, SAP type 1, earliest presentation time 0 ms.
A timeline with no records.
SAP type 0 for Object 1: 3.6.1 'The value 0 indicates that the Object does not start with an ISOBMFF stream access point.'
An earliest presentation time of -33. 3.6.1 'The data field is a JSON Array containing two integers.' The draft bounds the first integer and not the second.
Two records for Location [0,0] that disagree on the SAP type. No draft says which applies; a reader keeps both, in payload order, and reports the disagreement.
SAP type 0 for Object 0. 3.6.1 'When the Object is the first Object in the Group, the value MUST be equal to 1 or 2.' MSF-01 6.2: 'Object ID MUST be zero for the first Object within a Group'.
SAP type 3 for Object 0 of Group 2. 3.6.1 'When the Object is the first Object in the Group, the value MUST be equal to 1 or 2.' MSF-01 6.2 makes Object 0 the first.
SAP type 4. 3.6.1 'The first integer defines SAP type with an allowed value of 0,1,2 or 3.'
SAP type -1. 3.6.1 'The first integer defines SAP type with an allowed value of 0,1,2 or 3.'
SAP type as the string "2". 3.6.1 'The data field is a JSON Array containing two integers.'
An earliest presentation time of 33.3. 3.6.1 'The data field is a JSON Array containing two integers.' 3.6.1 gives it 'rounded to the nearest millisecond'.
data with three integers. 3.6.1 'The data field is a JSON Array containing two integers.'

data as a JSON Object. 3.6.1 'The data field is a JSON Array containing two integers.' MSF-01 8.1 speaks of 'A 'data' Object' whose structure the eventType defines; for this eventType CMSF defines it as an Array.
A record without data. 3.6.1 defines the record by its index reference and its data field. MSF-01 8.1 lists both as 'required fields'.
A record indexed by wallclock time 't'. 3.6.1 'The index reference MUST be 'l' for Location'.
A record indexed by media PTS 'm'. 3.6.1 'The index reference MUST be 'l' for Location'.
A record with both 'l' and 't'. 3.6.1 'The index reference MUST be 'l' for Location'. MSF-01 8.1: 'Only one of these index values may be used within each record.'
A payload missing its closing bracket.
One record that is not inside an array. MSF-01 8.1: 'The document contains an array of records.'
A record written as an array. MSF-01 8.1: 'Each record consists of a JSON Object'.
A Location with one item. MSF-01 8.1: 'Location value is an Array of Numbers, where the first item represents the MOQT GroupID and the second item the MOQT Object ID.'
A Location whose Object ID is 1.5. MSF-01 8.1 makes the second item 'the MOQT Object ID', an integer in MOQT.
